entities.name: Władysław Siemaszko
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Władysław Siemaszko was a Polish publicist and lawyer, a member of the Polish resistance Armia Krajowa (AK), and author of numerous publications focusing on the massacres of Poles in Volhynia. He was the father of writer Ewa Siemaszko, co-author of Ludobójstwo dokonane przez nacjonalistów ukraińskich na ludności polskiej Wołynia 1939–45 consisting of two volumes of 1,500 pages of research.
